title: Jake Barber in the GATE program as a child

tellings.quote: >> I was in the gate program as a kid. Gate program is a program that it's an acronym for gifted and talented education

plain: As a boy, Jake Barber was placed in GATE, a school programme whose name stands for Gifted and Talented Education. Barber tells this himself, in an interview where he says he was taken into a UFO programme as a child. He brings it up as part of his account of how he was picked out early in life.
